class.name: GFVoronoi2D
class.description: GFVoronoi2D: 通用二维 Delaunay 三角剖分与 Voronoi 图计算工具。 输入为纯 Vector2 点集，输出结构化 Dictionary 数据。工具不生成 Mesh、Node、场景、 地形、材质或编辑器交互，项目层负责解释点和多边形的业务含义。

member.name: DEFAULT_MAX_POINTS
member.description: 默认最大输入点数，用于避免误把实时大批量数据交给 O(n²) 纯 GDScript 计算。

member.name: build_delaunay
member.signature: static func build_delaunay(points: PackedVector2Array, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
member.description: 基于点集生成 Delaunay 三角剖分。

tags.tag: options: 可选参数，支持 epsilon 和 max_points。
options: Dictionary with optional epsilon: float and max_points: int.

return: Dictionary with ok: bool, error: String, input_point_count: int, point_count: int, duplicate_count: int, points: PackedVector2Array, triangles: Array[PackedInt32Array], and edges: Array[PackedInt32Array].

member.name: build_voronoi
member.signature: static func build_voronoi(points: PackedVector2Array, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
member.description: 基于点集生成 Voronoi 图。

tags.tag: options: 可选参数，支持 epsilon 和 max_points。
options: Dictionary with optional epsilon: float and max_points: int.

return: Dictionary with Delaunay fields plus vertices: PackedVector2Array and cells: Array[Dictionary]. Each cell contains point_index: int, point: Vector2, vertex_indices: PackedInt32Array, polygon: PackedVector2Array, and is_open: bool.
